facts.fact: coda 开场三连复诵（Ep10 的 Pink Eye TV 口述将由此展开）
facts.anchor: I’m telling myself the story of my life.

facts.fact: 童话体：一个孩子、一个 imaginary friend 名叫 Bethany——「I'm not going to tell you the name of the child because it doesn't matter.」——Bethany 美丽/勇敢/坚强/果决，敢做孩子没勇气做的冒险——「To him, she was real.」
facts.anchor: an imaginary friend, and her name was Bethany.

facts.fact: 病历：父母担忧送精神病医生——拒谈（「knew she wouldn't understand the way that Bethany was real」）只哭；16 岁崩溃、自杀未遂——imaginary friend Bethany 制止了他
facts.anchor: refused to talk to the psychiatrist

facts.fact: 医院转折：被送入院、被要求承认 Bethany 不存在——「could admit Bethany was in his head. could admit she was imaginary. But if he admitted she wasn't real, everything would be lost——她救过他，他需要她 real」——决定「make it real」：转变发生于此——孩子变成了 Bethany（brave/strong/resolved/beautiful/real）

反转镜像：成为真人后她发现自己也有一个赶不走的 imaginary friend——「It was the child she had been…Once she had been the boy's imaginary friend, and now he had become hers. He lived inside her head just as she had once lived inside him. And he was still broken. Broken forever.」
facts.anchor: as if they had switched places

facts.fact: 交易论：口述第四次复诵加了括号「(instead of living it)」——Bethany 意识到自己十六岁那夜立过约：「Bethany had kept him alive. And now as long as Bethany was alive herself, he still would be as well, scared and shattered in his childhood bedroom. So he lived with her.」——「Had she created him or had he created her?」——收尾引 Fran 谜语：「What never stops changing but always remains static?」
